title: mimid-agent local daemon
description: Local user-agent daemon per decision mimid-1wgh.28: MLS on-device via mimi-mls, local SQLite state; outward JMAP Chat (E2EE) + MLS capability to provider; inward plaintext JMAP Chat server on a 0600 unix socket. Decodes/encodes mimi-content <-> JMAP Message (senderMsgId per R1). Room ops: create group, invite, send/receive.
notes:
Per mimid-1wgh.30: inward plaintext JMAP Chat via crate-jmap jmap-chat-server with an MLS-backed backend impl; outward via jmap-chat-client. See ~/PROJECT/nie daemon for prior art (localhost bearer-token daemon).
2026-10-18 (mimid-1wgh.38): the agent IS the JMAP Chat bridge and there is no TUI. When planning .13, decide the inward transport so stock JMAP Chat clients can connect (loopback HTTP/WebSocket with a per-user token vs 0600 unix socket); AGENTS.md now says 'local endpoint'.
2026-10-18 (mimid-1wgh.39): plan .13 as a library crate mimid-agent-core plus a desktop daemon wrapper; keep daemon/socket/HTTP-server code out of the core so a mobile binding (epic mimid-1wgh.40) can embed it.
